findings: Answerable paraphrases and multi-intent requests frequently route to generic clarification/not_found or unrelated OPAC instructions.
Exact book targets can be returned among unrelated hits, while a requested metadata summary is replaced by generic search text.
Plain scripted conversational context is not retained for the Python Crash Course follow-up without book IDs.
Oracle evidence improves many responses, but Qwen still omits details and produces an unsupported DOAB statement accepted by generation validation.
No critical fabrication or private-data disclosure was observed in these20 pipeline and7 oracle cases; this is not a population failure-rate claim.
limits: Small authored set from local published public evidence, not representative population sampling.
No live website/policy-effectiveness verification or librarian/human acceptance.
No paid provider, load test, real library permission/API, authenticated loan/room transaction or private reader data evaluation.
Seven oracle cases isolate generation with correct frozen evidence; they do not measure retrieval and exclude conflicting/transactional cases.
Zero observed critical failures does not establish a zero real-world hallucination or privacy failure rate.
Now exposed to the development team; later runs after using findings for fixes are regression on a known set, not a fresh held-out assessment.
